wildcard_output.help: The workspace forwards `wildcard_output` in the CipherStrike POST body unchanged after stripping empty optional fields. The NyxStrike connector binds it to the integration listed for your catalogue slug. If executions reject the value, open the bastion-side wrapper scripts to confirm quoting, path expectations, type coercion, or privilege requirements before escalating.
